te: François Grimaldi, disguised as a monk, leads his men to capture the fortress protecting the Rock of Monaco, establishi…
dz: 弗朗索瓦·格里马尔迪乔装成僧侣，率领部下攻占了保护摩纳哥岩石的要塞，确立了家族作为摩纳哥统治者的地位。
de: François Grimaldi, disguised as a monk, leads his men to capture the fortress protecting the Rock of Monaco, establishing his family as the rulers of Monaco.

t: 由威廉·华莱士和安德鲁·莫赖联合率领的苏格兰人击败了英国人.
te: Scots jointly led by William Wallace and Andrew Moray defeat the English.
dz: 斯特林桥之战:由威廉·华莱士和安德鲁·莫赖联合率领的苏格兰人击败了英国人.
de: Battle of Stirling Bridge: Scots jointly led by William Wallace and Andrew Moray defeat the English.

t: 葡萄牙国王德尼和卡斯蒂利亚国王斐迪南四世在教皇调解下签订的"阿尔卡涅斯条约"确定了两国的边界并…
te: The Treaty of Alcañices, mediated by the pope, between the king Denis of Portugal and king Ferdinand IV of Castile defi…
dz: 葡萄牙国王德尼和卡斯蒂利亚国王斐迪南四世在教皇调解下签订的"阿尔卡涅斯条约"确定了两国的边界并建立了友谊联盟.
de: The Treaty of Alcañices, mediated by the pope, between the king Denis of Portugal and king Ferdinand IV of Castile defines the border between the two countries and establishes an alliance of friendship.

t: 帕干国王克约斯瓦被三个明赛会兄弟推翻,标志着帕干王国事实上的终结.
te: King Kyawswa of Pagan is overthrown by the three Myinsaing brothers, marking the de facto end of the Pagan Kingdom.
dz: 帕干国王克约斯瓦被三个明赛会兄弟推翻,标志着帕干王国事实上的终结.
de: King Kyawswa of Pagan is overthrown by the three Myinsaing brothers, marking the de facto end of the Pagan Kingdom.
